title: Lower urgency compressor case
description: Alternative compressor case with a longer failure horizon and lower operational pressure. It is useful to show that not every alert becomes a high-priority case.

layer1.information: Industrial air compressor; medium criticality; utility area
No repeated bearing interventions in recent history

layer2.information: Moderate production pressure; feasible stop in 96h
Standard spare available; technician available this week
Human review recommended but not mandatory

layer3.information: Case owner assigned; monitoring task active
Inspection can be planned within weekly schedule

layer4.information: Medium priority rule: longer horizon + moderate operational pressure

expected_layer_outputs.layer1: Validated evidence package: early anomaly, condition trend, asset context, and maintenance history
expected_layer_outputs.layer2: Contextualized decision profile: medium urgency, distant downtime window, intervention feasible, review recommended
expected_layer_outputs.layer3: Decision-ready case: open, monitoring task active, no blockers
expected_layer_outputs.layer4: Decision record: medium priority, planned inspection recommended
expected_layer_outputs.layer5: Governed recommendation package: monitoring summary, traceability index, and inspection proposal
